_doc: Legend's-memory encounters (05-formations.md), one per authored advanced class. Same shape as data/encounters (art empty). Choice 'legend': true makes the hero Legendary; the other is an ordinary memory and closes the gate for this run. Used only by legend_gate.gd.

encounters.title: A Legend's Memory: The Lantern Saint
encounters.text: A knight of the first Lanternrest, who held the gate alone for a night and a day. Her oath still hangs in the air here, waiting for a voice.

choices.label: Take up her oath
choices.outcome: Her oath settles on you like armor. You are not only yourself anymore.

choices.label: Let her rest
choices.outcome: You leave the oath unspoken. Somewhere, a gate closes gently.

encounters.title: A Legend's Memory: The Red Tide
encounters.text: A warlord whose fury held back the first Fading for a season. His rage is still here, pacing in the dark.

choices.label: Let the fury in
choices.outcome: It is not your anger. It fits anyway.

encounters.title: A Legend's Memory: The Last Blade of Veil
encounters.text: A duelist who never lost, and never said why she fought. Her stance is etched into the floor.

choices.label: Step into her stance
choices.outcome: Your feet find the marks. Your blade remembers what it never learned.

choices.label: Step around it
choices.outcome: The marks fade behind you, patient.

encounters.title: A Legend's Memory: The Quiet Hand
encounters.text: Nobody remembers his face. That was the point. His last contract waits here, unsigned.

choices.label: Sign the contract
choices.outcome: Your name goes where his should be. Already, people find it hard to remember you.

choices.label: Burn the contract
choices.outcome: Ash, and a sense of someone stepping back into the shadows.

encounters.title: A Legend's Memory: The Mother of Wicks
encounters.text: She kept the sick alive through the first Fading with nothing but a candle and a refusal. Her candle is still burning.

choices.label: Take up her candle
choices.outcome: The flame does not burn you. It knows your hand.

choices.label: Leave it burning
choices.outcome: Let it light someone else's way.

encounters.title: A Legend's Memory: The Gray Shepherd
encounters.text: He tended the dead when the living would not. The Fading's flock still answers to his crook.

choices.label: Take up the crook
choices.outcome: Something gray turns to face you, and kneels.

choices.label: Lay it down
choices.outcome: The flock scatters into the mist.

encounters.title: A Legend's Memory: The First Scholar
encounters.text: The Lumari who first wrote memory into crystal. Her last equation hangs unfinished in the air.

choices.label: Finish the equation
choices.outcome: The answer is you. It has been you since you came in.

choices.label: Leave it unsolved
choices.outcome: Some answers should not be written down.

encounters.title: A Legend's Memory: The Debt-Binder
encounters.text: A sorcerer who borrowed from the Fading itself and never paid. The debt waits here, compounding.

choices.label: Assume the debt
choices.outcome: Power, and the long cold patience of something owed.
